meta.name: Pyxl.Papyr.Puppyt — Keystone Rig
meta.units_note: 1 pyxl = 1 px = default smallest value (render scale)

coordinate_system.x_axis: left negative, right positive, 0 = vertical midline (character's left/right)
coordinate_system.y_axis: upper body: Y negative = up, lower body: Y positive = down. 0,0 at groin center, X centered on hips, Y at bottom-most groin point

meta.archetype: Vitruvian neutral — no archetype variants in v1

anchorstone.navel_height: 3/5 total height from crown to toe
anchorstone.dynamic_anchors: UNDEFINED — anchorstone may have dynamic options later

keystone_rules.keystone: source of rotation for a piece and all of its children; carries ancestors when it rotates
keystone_rules.bone_growth: bones grow/shrink from their parent keystone (e.g. forearm grows from elbowpoint, bicep from shoulderpoint)
keystone_rules.rotation: unconstrained in v1 — constraints deferred to later stage
keystone_rules.naming: all joints use -point suffix: shoulderpoint, elbowpoint, etc.

head.note: Head is a complex shape — one of three (head, torso, hips). Treated as its own feature set, beamed onto the rig like an antenna.
head.detail_level: nasalpoint down to vpoint / applepoint is the only bone for v1 — head features are their own

keystones.label: Groin
keystones.pos_note: rig origin — center X, bottom-most groin Y

keystones.label: Navel / Anchorstone
keystones.pos_note: 3/5 height from crown; ~1 head above groinpoint (Vitruvian, approximate — refine later)

keystones.label: Hip Left
keystones.pos_note: off-center groin point for hips — character's left

keystones.label: Hip Right
keystones.pos_note: off-center groin point for hips — character's right

keystones.pos_note: Vitruvian femur ≈ 2 heads = 56 pyxl — refine later

keystones.label: V-point (neck base)
keystones.pos_note: neck base at V of neck — ~2 heads above navel — refine later

keystones.label: Applepoint (Adam's apple)
keystones.pos_note: neck piece 1/2 — equal length/width. 2-piece neck, V→nasal inactive — functions as 1-point in v1

keystones.label: Chinpoint / Chin joint
keystones.pos_note: chin joint — default rotational center for the head, connects into neck chain

keystones.label: Nasalpoint / Face keystone
keystones.pos_note: face keystone — beneath nose cavity. Skull/eyes/cheeks/mouth/jaw rotate from here. V→nasal INACTIVE in v1. Head features beamed independently — like an antenna.

bones.note: V→nasal INACTIVE in v1 — functions as 1-point. Head features beamed independently.

head_complex.note: Head is a complex shape — features beamed independently onto nasalpoint. Full pupyl data from Pyxl.Proportions.
